name: Battle Performance (Combat)
body:
You can play your instrument and use it as a weapon at the same time.

Prerequisites: Proficiency in a musical instrument weapon or Catch Off-Guard and Equipment Trick (instrument), bardic performance or raging song class feature, Perform 1 rank.

Benefit: Whenever you make a full attack with a musical instrument used as an improvised weapon or a normal weapon while you are maintaining a bardic performance, you can maintain the bardic performance for that round without expending one of your rounds of performance for the day. In addition, while you wield a musical instrument as a weapon, the time required to begin a bardic performance or switch from one bardic performance to another is reduced by one step (from a standard action to a move action, from a move action to a swift action, and from a swift action to an immediate action).
